Historic England NHLE 1403515 independently confirms Grade II Weston-super-Mare Library at the same Boulevard address, first listed 2011-12-14, describing a purpose-built public library erected 1900 by Hans Fowler Price with SJ Wilde and PG Fry. Building status BUILDING_PRESENT and type Library are supported. No current operation or canonical parcel materialization is inferred.
